suite.doc: EC IUD Test - Meter (Configuration > Assets > Dispatching Objects, OV_METER). OV-GM (BU-gated) with a mandatory Delivery Point Name POPUP (the GENERIC T1 "Pick From EC Object Popup", resources/popup.resource - preserved unchanged by this conversion; see meter_page.resource Documentation). Meter's navigator was re-confirmed live 2026-08-26 as a single-dropdown shape identical to Area's own - this corrects an EARLIER WRONG "DOES NOT FIT" classification that had conflated the insert form's orthogonal Delivery Point popup with the navigator itself. Uses a FIXED test code (AUTOTEST_METER) rather than a generated/timestamped code - confirmed absent from OV_METER (2026-08-26, fresh oracledb connection) before this was wired in. Every run must complete TC05 (delete) so the code is free for the next run.
